observationsNotAffectingTheVerdict: participant-instructions.md and the filing-instructions component both say 'A certificate of service is included only where local practice requires you to serve the prosecutor directly - ask the clerk.' No certificate of service is in this packet: the manifest names six components and none is one, and TX.memo's own components[] names none either. The sentence is a carry of the memo's rules.service prose into a document that is describing its own contents, and a participant in such a county will look for a page that is not there. It is not failed here because no required component is missing, the substantive service rule is stated correctly, and the packet's authoritative self-description — its component table — does not list one. The sibling family tx_nd_conviction_no_supervision-set handles the identical situation properly by shipping a conditional proof-of-delivery component and saying so. Cheapest repair: reword to 'this packet does not include a certificate of service; ask the clerk whether that county requires you to serve the prosecutor directly and to prepare one.'

outlivesTheseFive.id: requiredComponentsMissing cannot see the packet-set manifest

It never reads data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json. A component the route requires and the build never declared is therefore invisible, and requiredComponentsMissing reports 0.

outlivesTheseFive.whyItMattersBeyondColorado: every family whose manifest names more components than its build declares is currently passing this counter. Nobody knows how many that is, because the instrument that would count them is the one with the blind spot.
outlivesTheseFive.suggestedFix: add a second denominator to the check: the packet-set manifest's components[] filtered to requirement 'required', mapped by officialFormId or componentId onto rendered documents. Then run it across all 346 families and see what falls out.

outlivesTheseFive.id: Colorado's notice and second order are identified, and the record says they are not

outlivesTheseFive.id: SELF_HELP_STOP is read two different ways across the cohort

outlivesTheseFive.id: A worktree can inherit a sparse-checkout cone and measure a tree that is not there
outlivesTheseFive.what: `git worktree add` in this repository produced a checkout with core.sparseCheckout true and a cone excluding /data/* except data/rcap-grade-a/ — 11,068 of 15,639 tracked files absent, including the whole of data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1. Every packet directory a verifier reads was outside it. `git ls-files` still reports the paths, so a script that lists families from the index and then stats them on disk sees a complete list and an empty tree.
outlivesTheseFive.suggestedFix: one line in the verifier and builder preflight: fail when `git ls-files -v` reports any skip-worktree entry, or when data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1 does not exist. The preflight already distinguishes an absent tree from an empty one for the Master Library; it does not do it for the census.
